word-astronomy.def: the study of stars, planets and space

word-theory.def: an idea or set of ideas that explains how or why something happens

word-laboratory.def: a room with special equipment where scientists do experiments

word-microscope.def: a tool that makes very small things look big enough to see

word-telescope.def: a tool that makes faraway things, such as stars, look closer

word-atom.def: the smallest part of a chemical substance that can exist

word-molecule.def: a group of atoms joined together

word-cell.def: the smallest living part of a plant or animal body

word-dna.def: the substance in living things that carries the information for how they grow

word-evolution.def: the slow change of living things over many generations

word-species.def: a group of animals or plants that can have babies together

word-chemical-element.def: a pure substance, such as gold or iron, made of only one kind of atom

word-oxygen.def: the gas in the air that people and animals need to breathe

word-hydrogen.def: the lightest gas, which joins with oxygen to make water

word-carbon.def: a substance found in coal, diamonds and all living things

word-force.def: a push or pull that changes how an object moves

word-gravity.def: the pull that makes objects fall toward the Earth

word-magnet.def: a piece of metal that pulls iron and steel toward it

word-mass.def: the amount of matter in an object

word-pressure.def: the push that something puts on each part of a surface

word-radiation.def: energy that travels through space as rays or tiny particles

word-nuclear.def: using or relating to the energy stored in the center of atoms

word-solar-system.def: the sun and all the planets and other objects that move around it

word-galaxy.def: a huge group of stars, gas and dust held together in space

word-universe.def: all of space and everything in it

word-orbit.def: the curved path of an object that moves around a planet or star

word-satellite.def: a moon or a machine that travels around a planet

word-rocket.def: a tube-shaped vehicle that flies into space by burning fuel

word-astronaut.def: a person trained to travel and work in space

word-comet.def: a bright ball of ice and dust with a long tail that moves around the sun

word-asteroid.def: a small rocky object that moves around the sun

word-black-hole.def: a place in space where gravity is so strong that not even light can escape

word-mercury-planet.def: the planet closest to the sun

word-venus.def: the second planet from the sun, very hot and bright

word-mars.def: the red planet, fourth from the sun

word-jupiter.def: the biggest planet in our solar system, fifth from the sun

word-saturn.def: the planet with large bright rings, sixth from the sun

word-uranus.def: the seventh planet from the sun, which looks blue-green

word-neptune.def: the planet farthest from the sun, deep blue in color

word-fossil.def: the hardened remains of an ancient plant or animal found in rock

word-dinosaur.def: a very large reptile that lived on Earth millions of years ago

word-invention.def: a new machine or tool that someone made for the first time

word-discovery.def: something that people find or learn about for the first time

word-formula.def: a rule or fact written with numbers or letters, used in math and science

word-sample.def: a small amount of something taken to test or study

word-observe.def: to watch something carefully to learn about it

word-analyze.def: to study something closely to understand it or its parts

word-chemical.def: relating to the substances that things are made of and how they change

word-liquid.def: a substance, like water, that flows and has no fixed shape

word-solid-matter.def: a hard substance that keeps its shape, not a liquid or gas

word-acid.def: a sour substance that can burn skin or dissolve metal
